name: hope-plateforme
description: HOPE : la plateforme de l'ONG (API Express et frontend React), deployee en un seul service.

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.db:preparer: npm run db:init --prefix backend && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend
scripts.db:premier-deploiement: npm run db:preparer && npm run db:seed --prefix backend && npm run db:categories --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix e2e
